SYMPTOM: Exercise (5k run) and cold exposure (cold shower) on March 9, 2026 produced zero motivational lift or reward response — 'I feel awful.'

CAUSE: Consistent with dopamine floor theory — reward circuit not responsive to natural stimuli. Not a willpower deficit.

SIGNIFICANCE: Strongest behavioral evidence yet that the dopaminergic deficiency is real. Natural dopamine triggers (exercise, cold exposure) that reliably produce reward in neurotypical people had zero effect. This is the opposite of the modafinil response.

CLINICAL USE: When speaking to psychologist Monday — 'I ran 5k and took a cold shower — two of the strongest natural dopamine triggers — and felt nothing. This is not a lifestyle problem.'

PREVENT MISINTERPRETATION: Don't frame this as depression or laziness. Negative emotions accessible, positive absent = dopamine reward circuit specifically, not global emotional shutdown.
